groups.instruction: What reason do teachers give for using each of the following picture books with children? Choose SIX answers from the box and write the correct letter, A-I, next to questions 21-26.

bank.t: The pictures show changing times of day.
The words are fun to say out loud.
It has an uncommon plot structure.
The text can easily be turned into song.
The pictures were done by a famous illustrator.
There is a surprise at the end of the story.
The pictures are simple line drawings.

groups.instruction: Choose TWO letters, A-E. Which TWO points from Smith's article about picture books did both speakers find surprising?

options.t: the argument that they are not literature
the lack of research about this age group
the popularity of books from overseas

groups.instruction: Choose TWO letters, A-E. Which TWO aspects of picture books do the speakers agree to talk about in their presentation?

options.t: the material they are made from
the variety of roles in them
